visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Integer.compare Instead of an if Ladder
visualizerParams.problemDescription: compareTo uses an if / else-if / else ladder to return -1, 1 or 0. Replace the ladder with Integer.compare. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Integer.compare does the three-way comparison correctly. (Writing score - other.score instead would overflow for very large or very small values, which is why Integer.compare is preferred.)
